career_roadmap.action: Submit the qwen2.5:14b rewrite to Mick@brendaandmicksrepairs-example.co.uk, emphasizing any transferable skills (e.g., customer service, problem-solving) and willingness to learn repair techniques on the job.

Enroll in a certified computer repair course (e.g., CompTIA A+ or local vocational training) to gain foundational technical skills, focusing on hardware diagnostics, OS troubleshooting, and basic component upgrades.

With 2–3 years of experience, pursue supervisory roles in repair shops or freelance computer repair services, leveraging the flexibility and trust-based culture highlighted in the job listing’s ‘What We Offer’ section.
